facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 56°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 2 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Fish Lake (3,440 ft) and Sasse Ridge (4,340 ft) 14 to 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: left April 30; earlier seasons: May 16 (2023), May 14 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Sasse Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 25; earlier seasons: May 17 (2023), May 14 (2024), May 15 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Fish Lake (3,440 ft) and Sasse Ridge (4,340 ft).

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: 13.2 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 24.6 in (2023), 19.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Sasse Ridge
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 30.7 in (2023), 22.6 in (2024), 28.6 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 21 and June 29, carried from the melt-out date at Sasse Ridge (4,340 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Sasse Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 25, 1,756 ft below the pass; points to April 21 to June 29
